shots.action: Bobo immediately crouches toward the existing loose yellow floor block. He puts one palm against its side and pushes gently. The block barely moves. Keep the tall tower untouched.
required_evidence: Hand reaches toward existing floor block within 0.5 seconds
Palm visibly contacts the same block
Block remains nearly in its original position
shots.end_pose: Bobo crouched beside the block, one palm resting against it.

shots.action: Starting from the supplied pose, Bobo places both palms against that same loose floor block and leans forward. The block slides a short distance away from him. Bobo takes one small balancing step forward. Tower remains untouched.
required_evidence: Both palms contact same floor block
One small balance adjustment; no collapse
shots.end_pose: Bobo beside the shifted block with both feet on the floor.

shots.action: Bobo eases the same block into place with one final small push, withdraws both hands, then alternates pointing at the block and himself with a small shoulder wiggle. Keep the final three seconds visibly active. No open-mouth laughing.
required_evidence: Purposeful pointing and shoulder movement through ending
shots.end_pose: Bobo and the block both clearly visible.

review_policy: Planned evidence is not observed evidence. Observe actual source at >=4fps, transitions8fps; finish captions, one mandatory voice line and natural foley only from actual actions. No automatic quality approval.
